name: JANUS_ECHO_COUSTEAU_TRANSFORMED_ECHO_REVERSE_OPERATOR
purpose: Infer whether an anomalous received sonar/acoustic contact can be explained by a stationary resonant/scattering structure whose transfer function transforms an incident military or survey acoustic field, while explicitly accounting for the outbound and inbound legs of an active-sonar echo.

round_trip_forward_model.equation: Y(f) = X(f) * H_tx(f) * S_target(f,theta_in,theta_out) * H_rx(f) + N(f)
round_trip_forward_model.reciprocal_stationary_shortcut: H_tx approximately equals H_rx only when the environment and geometry justify reciprocity over the ping round trip; otherwise retain separate legs.
round_trip_forward_model.physical_firewall: A transformed echo does not require literal transmission through the entire object. Resonance can enter the received echo through coupling, boundary scattering, cavity modes, ringing and reradiation.

mandatory_control_matrix.interpretation: A candidate must remain anomalous after comparison to natural resonators, biological emitters/scatterers, engineered resonant shells and known active-sonar illumination.

frequency_firewall.iceberg_harmonic_tremor: A published natural example with 40 Hz fundamental and 40 Hz overtone spacing contains a 520 Hz harmonic when enough overtones are present; absolute 520 Hz is therefore non-specific.
frequency_firewall.sei_whale: Published 200-600 Hz mid-frequency calls directly overlap the modeled neighborhood.
frequency_firewall.bio_duck: Antarctic minke bio-duck measurements cover approximately 40-500 Hz with harmonics reported to 2000 Hz; machine-like harmonic structure can be biological.
frequency_firewall.fish_swimbladder: Gas-filled swimbladders are resonant acoustic scatterers and can transform incident sonar returns.
frequency_firewall.elastic_shell: Submerged elastic shells are a positive control for resonance-rich transformed backscatter and ringing, not evidence for any specific geometry.
frequency_firewall.surtass_lfa: 100-500 Hz is an incident-field illuminator band. A nearby transmitter frequency is not a target fingerprint.
frequency_firewall.noaa_upsweep: Retain as historical unresolved-signal context but reject from the modeled 520 Hz candidate set by absolute frequency under the currently verified NOAA spectrogram axis.

time_reversal_role.method: Backpropagate measured field through candidate outbound and return ocean transfer functions and look for stable spatial-temporal focusing of the residual target operator.
time_reversal_role.interpretation: A true stationary source/scatterer model should refocus consistently near one geodetic location across independent passes after environmental correction.
time_reversal_role.not_equivalent_to: playing audio backward or assuming causality reversal

motion_firewall.monostatic_stationary_point_reflector: For a correctly associated direct-path monostatic echo from a stationary point, apparent range-rate magnitude cannot exceed the platform radial speed solely because the platform moves.
motion_firewall.constant_resonant_delay: A fixed target group/ringing delay adds a range bias c*tau/2 but does not create sustained apparent target velocity.

pyramid_hypothesis_ceiling.simple_single_stationary_pyramid: Cannot by ordinary direct monostatic reflection reproduce a sustained torpedo-like closing rate followed by wake-following motion.
pyramid_hypothesis_ceiling.distributed_resonant_structure: TESTABLE_NEW_HYPOTHESIS_ONLY; may generate a moving apparent scattering locus if different stationary portions or propagation paths dominate at different times.
required_before_admission: raw complex or sufficiently detailed sonar track
